# Chickenloop — watersports job board & talent network
# https://www.chickenloop.com

Chickenloop is a global watersports job board and talent network covering kitesurfing, wing foiling, surfing, sailing, scuba diving, and yacht crew roles.

## Primary pages
- Jobs: https://www.chickenloop.com/jobs
- Companies: https://www.chickenloop.com/companies
- Map: https://www.chickenloop.com/map
- Career advice: https://www.chickenloop.com/career-advice

## Live job market insights (updated hourly)
These pages answer specific questions with real-time job counts from our database:
- https://www.chickenloop.com/insights
- https://www.chickenloop.com/insights/watersports-jobs-by-country
- https://www.chickenloop.com/insights/kitesurfing-jobs-by-country
